ICS 59.080.40TXD 351. ScopeThis standard prescribes constructional, performance and other requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) laminated woven lay flat tube for use in mains and submains of drip irrigation system. These lay flat tubes are not suitable for use in sprinkler system.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
